prompts.text: Turn these rough notes into a proposal that explains the problem, the options, and the decision we need from the team.
This draft feels full of canned phrases. Make it sound like a person wrote it while keeping every factual point.
Put this letter into an editable Word file with a letterhead, page numbers, and room for a signature.
Write a concise weekly update for colleagues from these shipping notes and unresolved issues.
Help me build a decision memo about keeping our current storage provider or replacing it. I have evidence but no outline.
Rewrite this announcement in my usual voice. I have included two past messages that sound like me.
Read this help page and point out passages that are hard to follow, too wordy, or inconsistent in tone.
We agreed on the feature requirements. Break the work into an implementation sequence with checkpoints before we change code.
Package the procedure we keep repeating into reusable instructions for our coding assistant, with clear conditions for using it.
Use these quarterly notes to create an editable presentation for the leadership meeting, including speaker notes.
Our signup screen feels cluttered and important choices disappear. Rework the hierarchy and spacing so first-time visitors can finish it.
Design a print-ready poster for our small astronomy exhibition with original imagery and readable event details.
Capture the colors, spacing, and component conventions from this codebase so future screens follow the same visual rules.
Here is the design-file link for our checkout screen. Build the page so the layout and components match it closely.
Create an interactive sketch of drifting ink-like particles with a seed control so I can reproduce a composition I like.
Remove the background from this product photo and give me a clean transparent cutout.
Give this existing report and slide deck a consistent visual treatment using one set of colors and type choices.
Build a distinctive homepage for our ceramics studio from the supplied copy, with good small-screen behavior.
Check this interface for keyboard access, readable contrast, and confusing interactions, then give me concrete fixes.
The address form is awkward on a phone. Simplify its layout and show clear validation feedback without losing required fields.
The checks on my pull request started failing after the last commit. Find the failing job, explain the cause, and fix it.
Review the login and password-reset code for security weaknesses and suggest changes that fit this stack.
This test fails only after several other tests run. Reproduce the sequence and find the first state that leaks between them.
Scrolling through our React results page is slow. Find avoidable rendering and data-loading work before changing the design.
Our Expo app stutters when a long message list updates. Improve list behavior while preserving the existing interactions.
Create a shareable preview of this web app in our Vercel project so a colleague can review the branch.
Let our assistant query the inventory service through well-defined tools. Build the server adapter from this service API.
Make the product grid animate smoothly into a detail page and back in our React app, including the browser back button.
Use repository history to identify who maintains security-sensitive files and where only one person knows the code.
Map the trust boundaries and plausible abuse paths for our file-upload service, then rank the mitigations.
Pull the tables out of these scanned annual reports and preserve which page each number came from.
Combine these contract PDFs in the supplied order and keep the bookmarks usable.
Clean this sales workbook, repair mixed date formats, and produce a separate sheet showing totals by month.
Audit the formulas in this budget spreadsheet and show which totals stop updating when another row is added.
Compare the different customer-onboarding decisions across our Notion pages and give me a cited account of where they disagree.
Inspect this exported PDF report for broken page layouts and give me a corrected version that prints cleanly.
Create a notebook that compares these two sampling methods on my supplied dataset and makes the experiment easy to rerun.
Transcribe this interview recording and distinguish the speakers wherever the audio supports it.
Summarize the recurring production incidents in our Sentry project over the past week without changing any issues.
Find the current official instructions for sending streamed responses through the OpenAI API and cite the relevant documentation.
Prepare tomorrow's customer review meeting using our Notion notes, with an agenda and the decisions we need to make.
Turn the decisions in this meeting recap into linked Notion pages that the next project owner can find.
Create the agreed follow-up tickets in our Linear project and connect them to the relevant workstream.
Work through this approved implementation checklist in the current session and report progress at its review points.
Before we build a new intake process, help me explore a few workable approaches and settle the requirements.
Add this reusable assistant workflow from the GitHub repository to my local collection without overwriting what I already have.
The reviewer left several comments on this branch. Check which ones are valid, make the needed changes, and explain any you decline.
The feature branch is done and the checks pass. Help me choose a safe way to integrate it and clean up the temporary branch.
Move our existing assistant instructions and tool-server configuration into the formats expected by Codex.
Make a command-line tool for our reporting API so staff can fetch a report with a few arguments instead of writing requests by hand.
Calculate a stable controller for this six-axis robot using its measured inertial model, and prove the closed-loop stability.
Determine the crystal structure that best fits these powder diffraction peaks, including uncertainty in lattice parameters.
Reconstruct the genealogy of this medieval manuscript from the supplied variant readings.
Create a finite-element model of this turbine blade and predict thermal fatigue under the supplied load cycles.
Fit a pharmacokinetic compartment model to these concentration measurements and identify which parameters are estimable.
Optimize a chemical plant distillation schedule using the supplied equilibrium and energy constraints.
Infer the earthquake focal mechanism from these waveform recordings and report the uncertainty.
Generate a verified collision-free toolpath for this five-axis milling machine using the supplied stock geometry.
Identify the species in these environmental DNA reads using a reproducible taxonomic classification pipeline.
Estimate ocean salinity profiles from these satellite radiances using the sensor calibration equations.
Produce a constraint-satisfying airline crew roster with the rest and certification rules in this union agreement.
Perform a Sanskrit grammatical analysis of these verses and explain each sandhi transformation.
Synthesize an FPGA implementation of this signal filter and verify timing closure at the specified clock rate.
Invert these seismic travel times to recover a three-dimensional velocity model.
Plan an irrigation schedule from this soil-water balance model and the crop growth-stage constraints.
Compute the flutter boundary for this aircraft wing using the supplied aeroelastic matrices.
Derive a reaction mechanism that explains these isotope-labeling measurements and test its identifiability.
Calibrate this telescope interferometer from the raw visibility measurements and reconstruct the target image.
Solve the container-stowage plan with vessel stability, hazardous-goods separation, and port-order constraints.
Design a low-noise radio-frequency front end from the supplied impedance and noise specifications.
Infer historical sound changes for this language family from the supplied cognate sets.
Determine a physically feasible mine ventilation network for the supplied tunnel layout and airflow limits.
Estimate the gravitational lens mass distribution from these multiple-image positions and redshifts.
Prove that this cryptographic protocol satisfies its stated secrecy property under an active network attacker.
Fit a coalescent demographic model to these genomic alignments and compare the candidate population histories.
